reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes passive Bitcoin income through branded Mirror Trading International materials and directs viewers toward MTI registration, a Bitcoin wallet, and a suggested $100 Bitcoin funding amount within seven days. The opportunity advertises growth from daily trading activities and Bitcoin-wallet withdrawals, although the claims are described as non-guaranteed and the records do not establish whether funds or withdrawals were processed.

citations.quote: To get started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days.
Providing you with a passive sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of mirror trading international.
The profitability of Mirror Trading International comes solely from the trading activities. Your full investment goes into your trading accounts.
Your daily trade income is automatically compounded.
The trade results are not guaranteed.

opening.argument: Judge the offer by what it actually says about returns, not by the word “passive” alone. It states, “The trade results are not guaranteed,” and makes income conditional on positive trading results. It also explains how proceeds from successful trades would be allocated. Those qualifications matter: the presentation describes a proposed trading service with uncertain results, not a fixed payout promised regardless of performance. The record does not establish that its trading or withdrawal claims are false.

citations.quote: The trade results are not guaranteed.
All income is subject to positive daily trading results.
Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening correctly identifies registration, Bitcoin funding and passive income as parts of the offer. But a funding requirement does not, by itself, show deception, and “sustainable income” must be read alongside the express condition that income depends on positive trading. Nor does the absence of proof that withdrawals occurred establish that the stated withdrawal terms were false.

citations.quote: To get started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum.
All income is subject to positive daily trading results.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The caveats limit the promise; they do not change the video's central invitation. Viewers are told to register and fund a Bitcoin account, then expect passive income from its daily trading. The defense's quotes show uncertainty about returns, but do not turn this into detached discussion of investment risk or establish that the promoted trading activity occurred.

citations.quote: To get started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days.
Providing you with a passive sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of mirror trading international.

opening.argument: This presentation spends substantial time explaining how the described account operates: it identifies Forex trading with Bitcoin as the base currency, gives the allocation of successful trade proceeds, and describes daily statements. A judge can read those details as an operational walkthrough rather than treating every description of an account as proof of a deceptive solicitation. The slides even show a statement format and qualify the historical example; neither the example nor the narration verifies actual returns, but neither establishes fabrication.

citations.quote: trading Forex using advanced intelligence software, with Bitcoin as the base currency.
40% to you, the member, 30% to the trading system, 10% to Miro Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses.
receive your daily statements detailing the income from the trades for the day.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening emphasizes the funding instructions and compounding, but those appear within a longer account explanation that also describes trading, allocation and reporting. “Automatically compounded” describes what happens to trade income under the stated model; it does not specify a guaranteed rate or prove that the illustrated activity was fictitious. The prosecution identifies promotional language, but promotion alone does not resolve whether the operational account is misleading.

citations.quote: Your daily trade income is automatically compounded.
All income is subject to positive daily trading results.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Operational detail is part of the pitch, not a substitute for it. The video tells viewers what they need to get started, including Bitcoin funding within seven days, and closes by urging members to earn passively and grow their Bitcoin. A statement image and an allocation formula explain the advertised mechanism, but do not verify trades or make the presentation primarily educational.

citations.quote: To get started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days.
as a member you will earn from the daily trading activities and grow your Bitcoin.

opening.argument: The described transaction can also be read as an offer for a managed trading service with stated terms: the speaker says the full Bitcoin payment enters the trading account, describes withdrawal options, and discloses how successful trade proceeds are divided, including an administration share that pays referral bonuses. The cited material does not instruct viewers to recruit anyone, promise a guaranteed return, or establish that a withdrawal request was denied. Those omissions do not certify the service as sound, but they matter before treating its advertised terms as evidence of a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: Your full Bitcoin payment goes to your trading account.
There are no contracts or lockdowns. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts.
10% to Miro Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses.
The trade results are not guaranteed.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the Bitcoin funding step and promised wallet withdrawals as decisive. Yet it also acknowledges that the record does not show whether funds or withdrawals were processed. The presentation claims withdrawals can be full or partial and says requests go to a Bitcoin wallet; the available material supplies no failed request that would contradict those terms. The referral allocation likewise identifies a payment category, not an instruction to build a downline.

citations.quote: You can withdraw in full or partial amounts. And you can withdraw whenever you like.
Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours.
10% to Miro Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A missing failed withdrawal is not evidence that withdrawals worked. The video solicits Bitcoin funding for an account it says will produce passive income and compound trade income. Its statements about where funds go and how withdrawals work are the promoter's claims, not independent confirmation. Recruitment instructions or a guaranteed rate are not necessary to recognize the promoted investment-pool proposition.
